description: Rothco's 10 inch Ripple Sole Desert Tan Jungle Boots combine classic style with modern features for optimal performance. Crafted from a durable blend of suede and leather, these boots provide robust protection and long-lasting wear. Whether trekking through rugged landscapes or engaging in outdoor activities, these boots are designed to keep you comfortable and secure. With a rich heritage spanning over 7 decades, Rothco is the go-to brand for all things that keep you standing on your feet.
